# uptimeify_customer (Data Source)

Look up one customer by `id` or by `name` (exactly one). Fails when no or several visible customers carry the name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_customer" "shop" {
  name = "Example Shop GmbH"
}

data "uptimeify_customer" "by_id" {
  id = "12"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Numeric id or public id. Use `tonumber(id)` for `customer_id` arguments.
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `public_id` (String)
- `status` (String) `active` or `inactive`.
